positive.point: Podz is one of the best rebounding guards in the league, ranking in the top 5, and is an efficient scorer with a high usage low turnover profile. He is also a good defender and is paid less than $4M a year.

Podz has stepped up massively since Steph went down, averaging 18.2 points, 7.7 rebounds, 4.4 assists, and 1.1 steals on 56% true shooting percentage over the last 10 games, which are fringe all-star numbers.

negative.point: Podz's ego and play have driven enough of his teammates to snap at him during games more than any other player on the team, and he gets more playing time at the expense of other young players.
There is frustration that Podz is getting 35 minutes per game, which is seen as a longer leash than other younger players, leading to complaints about his playing time.
Podz's ego is somewhat deserved, and there is a perception that the hate on him is disproportionate to his actual performance compared to other players.
